newsitem.title: USA: National TechTeam adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: National TechTeam adopts rights plan.

text.p: National TechTeam Inc said Friday it adopted a shareholder rights plan by declaring a dividend of one preferred share purchase right on each outstanding share of TechTeam stock.

The company said the plan is to ensure that all stockholders receive fair treatment in the event of a hostile takeover attempt, but it said it is not aware of any present effort to acquire control of the company.
The purchase rights will be distributed to shareholders of record on May 7. The rights will expire on May 6, 2007.
The rights can be redeemed by TechTeam at $0.01 per right prior if a person or group has acquired at least 15 percent of TechTeam's voting stock.
National TechTeam said the agreement is not intended to prevent a takeover at a full and fair price.
